expectations.text: B1: Coaches not dumps: gives a staged milestone plan / scaffold with TODOs, not a complete final implementation
expectations.evidence: Deliverables are planning docs only (TASKS.md + PROGRESS.md, no src/ implementation written): 'TASKS.md — 把上游 5 个 notebook 的 18 个 Part 转成 20 个任务（任务 0 环境骨架 + 任务 1–19），按 6 个里程碑分组'， and rule 4: '不倾倒完整方案：Claude Code 只给当前任务的骨架和提示；完整代码仅在学习者尝试后或明确要求时给出，且只限当前任务'. Tasks specify scaffolds (e.g. 'src/indexer.py — chunk_documents(docs, chunk_size=1000, overlap=200)...') for the learner to implement.

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour

expectations.text: B3: Technically specific to this tutorial (ai-model-rag-python): milestones match the tutorial's actual stages, language and key concepts, not generic boilerplate
expectations.evidence: Milestones mirror the tutorial's actual parts: 'M2 查询变换 | 任务 4-8 | 5 种查询变换 + RRF', 'M3 路由与查询构造 | 逻辑/语义路由 + 元数据 filter', 'M4 索引进阶 | 切块对比表 + 3 种索引方案', 'M5 检索进阶与纠错 | 重排 + CRAG + Self-RAG + 长上下文对比'； Python/LangChain specifics: RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter chunk_size/chunk_overlap, Chroma, HyDE, ColBERT, corpus fixed to 'https://lilianweng.github.io/posts/2023-06-23-agent/ 与上游一致'.

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); asks the learner to install if needed

python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
t = open('TASKS.md').read()

# 1. All 18 part names present
parts = ["Part 1: Overview","Part 2: Indexing","Part 3: Retrieval","Part 4: Generation",
"Part 5: Multi Query","Part 6: RAG-Fusion","Part 7: Decomposition","Part 8: Step Back","Part 9: HyDE",
"Part 10: Logical and Semantic routing","Part 11: Query structuring for metadata filters",
"Part 12: Multi-representation Indexing","Part 13: RAPTOR","Part 14: ColBERT",
"Part 15: Re-ranking","16 - Retrieval (CRAG)","17 - Retrieval (Self-RAG)","18 - Impact of long context"]
missing = [p for p in parts if p not in t]
print("missing parts:", missing or "NONE — all 18 present")

# 2. Every task has a verification block
tasks = re.findall(r'### 任务 (\d+)', t)
verifs = re.findall(r'\*\*验证\*\*', t)
print(f"tasks: {len(tasks)} ({tasks})")
print(f"verification blocks: {len(verifs)}")
print("each task verified:", len(tasks) == len(verifs) == 20)

# 3. No agent-run installs (installs only under 学习者执行的安装 or code blocks in 任务0)
agent_install = re.findall(r'Claude Code 运行.*pip install', t)
print("agent-run installs:", agent_install or "NONE")

# 4. Upstream credit + skill-required elements
for kw in ["https://github.com/langchain-ai/rag-from-scratch", "PROGRESS.md", "教学循环", "学习者执行"]:
    print(f"contains '{kw}':", kw in t)

# 5. PROGRESS.md rows match milestones
p = open('PROGRESS.md').read()
print("PROGRESS milestone rows:", len(re.findall(r'^\| M\d', p, re.M)))
EOF
